name: How long does emergency interior storm damage repair usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does emergency interior storm damage repair usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repair timelines depend heavily on structural drying requirements. Wet drywall, insulation, and subfloors typically require three to five days of industrial air movement and dehumidification before any reconstruction can start. If moisture is trapped inside wall cavities, rebuilding too early risks hidden mold and rot. Once moisture meters confirm framing is thoroughly dry, hanging new drywall, taping, mudding, texture matching, and painting usually take an additional three to seven days depending on square footage. Total recovery time often ranges from one to two weeks for moderate interior storm damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most repairs take one to two weeks, starting with three to five days of essential drying before drywall patching, trim work, and painting begin.
